result.note: E47's fix (structural loader + strengthened duplicate key) held under a fresh real application: the known E9 collision remains correctly non-flagged, and no new completeness gaps or false duplicates were introduced by this phase's own capture.

cause.root_cause_summary: A one-off fix verified only in the phase that introduced it is not yet proven operational -- confirming it holds under the very next real run is what makes it load-bearing rather than incidental.

lesson: Verifying a fix once, in the phase that discovers it, is not the same as verifying it operationally. Re-confirming E47's loader and duplicate key against a fresh real run -- including the specific collision case that motivated the fix -- is what actually closes the loop.
